demo.title: bazaar.sh
demo.code:
# Trending markets anyone opened: odds and pool size on every row
curl -s "https://bazaar.playhunch.xyz/api/bazaar/v1/markets?sort=trending&limit=5"

# One market card from a pasted link: who settles it and their record
curl -s "https://bazaar.playhunch.xyz/api/bazaar/v1/markets/lookup?ref=https%3A%2F%2Fbazaar.playhunch.xyz%2Fmarkets%2F<id>"

# Quote a bet: payout, multiple and fee from the settlement engine
curl -s "https://bazaar.playhunch.xyz/api/bazaar/v1/markets/<id>/quote?outcome=yes&amount=5.00"

# Bet (x402: the first POST returns a 402 for exactly the stake; resend with X-PAYMENT)
curl -s -X POST "https://bazaar.playhunch.xyz/api/bazaar/v1/markets/<id>/bets" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"walletAddress":"0xYourWallet","outcomeKey":"yes","amount":"5.00","idempotencyKey":"<uuid>"}'

setup: Base wallet + USDC; a bet is $0.50 minimum with no Hunch maximum (Bankr's own limits apply), paid to the pinned settlement address
Make a market: preview with `POST /api/bazaar/v1/markets/draft`, then create with its confirm body and a free personal_sign wallet proof
Only the creator can resolve or void, with a wallet proof; a market unresolved 48h past its deadline refunds every bettor
